patterns_observed: Top-level folders are category names (recipes, extensions, skills, integrations, schemas, primitives, dashboards, docs, server, resources)
Each contribution lives in its own named subfolder under the appropriate category (e.g. recipes/chatgpt-conversation-import, skills/panning-for-gold)
Contribution names are descriptive kebab-case slugs describing the capability
A _template folder exists in every open contribution category as a starter scaffold
Dashboards use framework-native routing conventions: SvelteKit uses src/routes/ with +page.svelte / +server.ts, Next.js uses app/ with page.tsx / route.ts and [id] dynamic segments
Some skills use a variants/ subfolder to hold client-specific variants (claude-code, claude-desktop, codex, anthropic)
Some skills and recipes use a references/ subfolder for supporting documentation
Some recipes include scripts/, sql/, src/, server/, curriculum/ subfolders when they are full applications rather than single-file scripts
